rows.relation: in_proj: sum_k a_k W_kj = 2^s x_j + r_j
rows.bounds_from: a: admit (M3a) or table clamp 2,047 (full model); W: key; x: rng; r: two key12 limbs; shift s <= 24: format

rows.relation: conv: acc = sum of 4 tap * x
rows.bounds_from: tap: key; x: rng
rows.then: acc is the integer filter sum

rows.relation: conv: 2^12 c + r = acc
rows.bounds_from: c: rng; r: key12

rows.relation: SiLU key: c = step (idx - off) + r
rows.bounds_from: idx: table key (exact, 12 bits); r: key12
rows.then: |c| < 8 * 2^F: the lookup domain bounds c exactly

rows.relation: q/k norm: sum x^2 + eps = sigma^2 + e1
rows.bounds_from: x: table (SiLU image)

rows.relation: q/k norm: 2^36 = Rc sigma + rr
rows.bounds_from: Rc: three key12 limbs; sigma: two key12 limbs

rows.relation: q/k norm: 2^24 k + r = x Rc
rows.bounds_from: k: rng; x: table; Rc: limbs
rows.then: k = floor(x Rc / 2^24), so |k| <= 2^12 (implied): k and q need no extra range check

rows.relation: gate: 2^F g + r = cA * sp
rows.bounds_from: cA: key; sp: table (softplus image); g: rng
rows.then: g is the integer decay exponent

rows.relation: recurrence: g1 = S * a
rows.bounds_from: S: rng; a: table (exp image, in [0, 2^F])

rows.relation: recurrence: g2 = S * k, P_j = sum_i g2
rows.bounds_from: S: rng; k: implied 2^12

rows.relation: recurrence: g5 = P_j * a
rows.bounds_from: P_j: sum above; a: table

rows.relation: recurrence: 2^2F (v - M) + r = g5.c
rows.bounds_from: M: rng; v: table; r: two key12 limbs

rows.relation: recurrence: g6 = (v - M) * beta
rows.bounds_from: beta: table (sigmoid image)

rows.relation: recurrence: g3 = k * delta
rows.bounds_from: k: implied; delta = 2^18 hi + lo, hi: rng, lo: rng

rows.relation: recurrence: 2^F S' + r = g1.c + g3.c
rows.bounds_from: S': rng; r: key12

rows.relation: output: 2^F o + r = sum_i S' * q
rows.bounds_from: S': rng; q: implied 2^12; o: rng

rows.relation: gated norm: sum o^2 + eps = sigma^2 + e1
rows.bounds_from: o: rng

rows.relation: gated norm: 2^24 w + r = o Rc
rows.bounds_from: o: rng; Rc: limbs; w: rng

rows.relation: gated norm: 2^F t + r = s * w
rows.bounds_from: s: table (SiLU image, |s| <= 4,095); w: rng (2^12 implied)

rows.relation: gated norm: 2^sg y + r = gain * t
rows.bounds_from: gain: key (|gain| <= 4,096); t: rng (2^12 implied); y: rng
rows.then: y = floor(gain t / 2^sg): no derived coefficient

rows.relation: out_proj: sum_j y_j Wo_jk = out_k
rows.bounds_from: y: rng; Wo: key; out: admit (M3a)
rows.then: the head contribution is the integer sum
